source.edition: Giuseppe Pitrè, Feste patronali in Sicilia, Carlo Clausen, Torino-Palermo, 1900, Biblioteca delle tradizioni popolari siciliane XXI
source.ocr_html_line_locator_definition: zero-based? no: lines labelled L# in Internet Archive web reader; numbers displayed by web source, not printed-page folios

caveats: Six local feast/event complexes, many nonliturgical civic spectacle components; source detail count is not unique-custom count.
1900 Pitrè is compiler of many named other authors and correspondents, older works must be directly verified to assert independence.
Same author's 1881 Spettacoli e feste is not independent corroboration.
1900 text read by direct Internet Archive OCR with exact web line locations; 632-page original scan failed large-file reader, so zero folio page image checks.
OCR may distort dates, names, historical claims; modern liturgical Calendar and current traditions not validated.
Folk magic, providential miracle accounts, contested healing and use of child performers or harmed animals preserved only as historical reports with holds.
